module.name: BNK Namespaces
module.description: Creates required namespaces for F5 BNK deployment: f5-bnk (TMM data plane), f5-operator (FLO/CNE control plane), f5-utils (utilities), and gateway namespace (Gateway API resources). Per F5 CloudDocs best practices.

optional.name: bnk_namespace
optional.description: Namespace for BNK data plane (TMM pods)

optional.name: operator_namespace
optional.description: Namespace for BNK control plane (FLO, CNE controller, CWC)

optional.name: utils_namespace
optional.description: Namespace for BNK utility components (IPAM, observability)

optional.name: create_gateway_namespace
optional.description: Whether to create the gateway namespace

optional.name: create_far_secrets
optional.description: Whether to create FAR image pull secrets in namespaces

optional.name: far_secret_name
optional.description: Name of the FAR image pull secret

key_outputs.name: bnk_namespace
key_outputs.description: Name of the BNK data plane namespace (TMM pods)

key_outputs.name: operator_namespace
key_outputs.description: Name of the BNK operator namespace (FLO, CNE, CWC)

key_outputs.name: utils_namespace
key_outputs.description: Name of the utilities namespace (IPAM, observability, dSSM)

key_outputs.name: namespaces_ready
key_outputs.description: Flag indicating all namespaces are ready
